name: warfront
description: WARFRONT: Global Conquest — mobile real-time strategy

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @warfront/server" "npm run dev -w @warfront/client"
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @warfront/server
scripts.dev:client: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @warfront/client
scripts.build:server: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @warfront/server
